name: hcportal_editKennel
description: Updates an existing kennel's settings. Update-only (no insert path). COALESCE pattern: a non-NULL parameter is written, NULL means 'leave unchanged'. Exceptions: @latitude or @longitude = -999.0 (or 999.0) sets both columns NULL, and an out-of-range coordinate is refused; @messagingGroupInviteUrl, @runsPageUrl, @cardPaymentProvider and @cardPaymentMerchantCode treat '' as 'clear to NULL'; other strings cannot be cleared. Covers identity, dissemination, Google Calendar, messaging group, payment config (3 slots), card payments (SumUp only), pricing, currency, location, tags, membership renewal, notifications, runs-page import and inbound integration, PackTrack trail config, and feature tier. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicKennelId as the callerParamString. Gate: the caller's HasherKennelMap row for the kennel must carry AppAccessFlags & 0x40000081 (superAdmin | authIsAdmin). Validation order: auth → publicKennelId NULL → runs page URL → social links → pack-off minutes → position range → inbound integration → KennelUniqueShortName uniqueness (with suggestions) → kennel exists → admin flags → card payment provider/merchant code. Several columns written here are newer than db/schema/tables/HC.Kennel.Table.sql; their types come from the run-once ALTER scripts named on each parameter. Idempotency: set-state — every column is written to the value sent; a repeat writes the same values again. Google Calendar (2026-10-15, E3.F6.S5): when this save sets or keeps InboundIntegrationId 2 (Google Calendar) and touches @inboundIntegrationId or @runsPageUrl, the effective runs-page address must be a Google Calendar link (https://calendar.google.com/calendar/… with src=, cid= or /calendar/ical/), else Success 0 with how to copy the calendar's public URL. The runs-page reader reads that calendar through its public iCal feed. Feedback-loop guard (2026-10-15): with InboundIntegrationId 2 (Google Calendar) and PublishToGoogleCalendar 1 after the save, Success 0 when the import calendar's id (from /calendar/ical/<id>/ or src=<id>) appears in PublishToGoogleCalendarAddresses, or cannot be read from the link (a base64 cid= share link).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on any validation, auth, permission or runtime error (CATCH returns ERROR_MESSAGE()). Short-circuits on first error. Duplicate KennelUniqueShortName errors include auto-suggested alternatives in ErrorMessage, which can exceed 255 characters.

rowsets.name: SuccessResult
rowsets.description: Returned after successful UPDATE of HC.Kennel.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Kennel — every non-NULL parameter via COALESCE, plus updatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME(); Latitude/Longitude NULL when either is -999.0 or 999.0; RunsPageHash cleared when the runs page address changes. Wrapped in a transaction. HC.trgUpdateModifiedOnDateForKennels also fires (kennel re-syncs to phones).
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change the lat/lon nulling sentinel (-999.0) without updating all callers

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 401-404: the CATCH rolls back and returns ERROR_MESSAGE() with no HC.ErrorLog row. The header relies on the API shim logging every Success = 0 (nonApi_logPortalError); a failure the shim does not see leaves no record.

@kennelName NVARCHAR(250), @kennelShortName NVARCHAR(25), @kennelDescription NVARCHAR(4000), @kennelMismanagementTeam NVARCHAR(4000), @kennelSearchTags NVARCHAR(4000), @messagingGroupInviteUrl NVARCHAR(500) etc. (lines 10-105) match their columns, but SQL Server truncates an over-long argument silently. Only @runsPageUrl is NVARCHAR(MAX) with a LEN check.

Lines 360-361: -999.0 on @latitude or @longitude clears both coordinates. Strings use '' to clear on four parameters and cannot be cleared at all on the rest — inconsistent clear semantics within one SP.

codeSmells.issue: Uniqueness check before kennel lookup, without lock
codeSmells.detail: Lines 201-246 check KennelUniqueShortName before the kennel is resolved and before the admin gate (so a non-admin learns which names exist), and without UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK; two concurrent edits can race to the same name (a unique index, if any, then fails into the CATCH).
Lines 261-270 test raw AppAccessFlags & 0x40000081; mismanagement-role grantors cannot edit the kennel here.
Line 327 writes any SMALLINT; the documented range is 1-7.
